title: Additive module lift for integral root transport
statement: The scalar semilinear additive map admits a morphism from the canonical module pullback whose underlying sheaf map satisfies the adjunction-unit section formula.

proof.text: Transpose the scalar-semilinear additive map through the canonical module adjunction. The resulting module morphism has the displayed underlying section formula by the adjunction hom-equivalence.
